text: はねに　りんぷんが　ついていて　ヒラヒラと　はばたくたびに　もうどくの　こなを　ばらまく。

structure.jp: はねに　りんぷんが　ついていて
structure.en: scales are stuck on its wings, and

structure.jp: ヒラヒラと　はばたくたびに
structure.en: every time it flutters its wings

structure.jp: もうどくの　こなを　ばらまく。

patterns.name: 〜たびに
patterns.explanation: A plain verb plus たびに means 'every time' that happens. はばたくたびに = 'every time it flaps'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている here says something has happened and stays that way. ついていて = 'are stuck on, and'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: Ending in て instead of finishing joins this part to the next with 'and'. ついていて = 'are stuck on, and'.
